question: The batch treats 'Agent Carter' as one whole-show title, but the show has seasons on file (stages use 'Agent Carter S1#N' / 'S2#N'), and 21 of these 25 pairs already have stages there. Should the whole-show 'Agent Carter' title be dropped from the per-title check (or mapped to its seasons) so these pairs stop being flagged?

The pass flags pairs under the bare 'Agent Carter' title even though every one already has stages titled 'Agent Carter S1...' or 'Agent Carter S2...', and the app maps the bare title onto S1 and S2. Should the checker treat the umbrella as covered by its seasons (drop these flags), or should these ties also get stages titled under the bare 'Agent Carter'?
